subject: c-fo-act
title: C.FO.ACT. ------ PRI.INFO.
description: Diagram in AE(PD)-16 (Aspect Essence / Perception Dynamics, Level One), first of three on book p128. Accompanies Braxton's two-conditions diagnostic of sixties activism: '(1) with respect to the composite focus of a given objective, and (2) with respect to the particulars of a given route. Both of these conditions are important if a given transition is to be achieved.' (C)C-FO-ACT (the concept of composite focused activism) is crossed with PRI-INFO (principle information): the question is what composite-focused-activism produces when crossed with principle-information — the activism-condition being held against the information-condition. T-C-IMP (temporal-continuity implication) and DYM-F (dynamics fundamentals) form the upper bridge. PART (participation) and LANG-DY (language dynamics) cluster on the upper-right output. PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) and MT-INFO (multi-information) form the lower-left upstream chain. PRI-INFO itself sits centrally. (R)INT (the reality of interior) and (C)POST (the concept of postulation) form the lower-right cluster. PROJ-CONT (projectional continuance) anchors the lower-center. Structural argument: composite-focused-activism crossed with principle-information is mediated by temporal-continuity-implication and dynamics-fundamentals as upper bridge, with progressional-continuance and multi-information as lower upstream. The mixed prefixes — (r) on int but (c) on post — register Braxton's structural distinction: real interior must obtain, but postulation is being held conceptually. The diagram is the structural case for why composite activism requires *principle*-information (not particular-information) as its crossing partner: the activism only sustains across the temporal continuity hub when principle-information is the partner.
